capabilities: Add configurable data attributes to File explorer folder elements
Keep rainbow folder colors stable while scrolling
Iterate colors through a chosen number of folders
Optionally apply the color iteration recursively to subfolders
disambiguation: Does not color folders itself; it only adds data attributes so your own CSS snippets or theme can assign colors.
extras: The author notes it was made for personal use, and the CSS example is only shown as a code placeholder; users must keep their own Nth-child CSS on hand if they stop using the plugin.
intentEvidence: solves the issue of rainbow folders changing colors as DOM elements are loaded and unloaded
motivation: The author says the plugin was made for personal use to solve this scrolling color issue in their own vault.
problem: Rainbow folder coloring via Nth-child CSS breaks as DOM elements are loaded and unloaded when scrolling the File explorer, making colors change.
summary: Utility that adds stable data attributes to File explorer folders so CSS snippets can keep rainbow folder colors fixed while scrolling.
